verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own Public API with API-key auth at api.otter.ai/v1. It gives programmatic, non-interactive access to conversations, transcripts, action items and more, which supports scripted or headless automation. That access is Enterprise-only, appears to be retrieval-focused, and is documented only as a prose article. Missing for 10: a CLI or documented CI/headless runner, any CI or automation guidance, write/trigger operations beyond data retrieval, a machine-readable spec or sandbox, availability below Enterprise, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Otter's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details
